name: dayjs-dst-demo
description: Reproduces dayjs #1271, #2609 and mui-x #10584 with emulated host timezones and mocked clocks, before vs after the fix

scripts.vendor: node scripts/vendor.mjs reported v1.11.10 && node scripts/vendor.mjs before dev && node scripts/vendor.mjs after fix/timezone-dst-arithmetic
scripts.build: for v in reported before after; do DAYJS_VARIANT=$v vite build --outDir dist/$v --logLevel error || exit 1; done
scripts.all: npm run vendor && npm run build && npm run evidence
